regulations.title: 방송표준방식 및 방송업무용 무선설비의 기술기준
regulations.note: Article 13 (terrestrial UHD television) defines the broadcasting standard method by reference to the TTA terrestrial UHDTV transmission/reception standards; paragraph ③ defers anything not specified to ITU conditions.

clauses.text: 방송신호는 비디오 서비스 신호, 오디오 서비스 신호 또는 데이터 서비스 신호로 구성될 것
방송신호의 표현 형식은 한국정보통신기술협회가 정한 "지상파 UHDTV방송 송수신 정합 표준"에서 규정하는 내용을 따를 것
비디오 신호의 압축 조건은 … ISO/IEC 23008-2의 Main 10 Profile 또는 Scalable Main 10 Profile, Main tier, Level 5.2의 내용을 따를 것
오디오 신호의 압축 조건은 … ISO/IEC 23008-3의 LC(low complexity) Profile, Level 1, 2 또는 3의 내용을 따를 것
다중화: 컴포넌트들을 하나의 프로그램 채널로 다중화; 전송채널(6㎒ 폭)에 적어도 하나의 4K UHDTV 프로그램 채널 포함; 다중화의 기술적 조건은 TTA 표준의 IP(Internet Protocol) 기반 다중화 방법을 따를 것
오류정정 방식은 LDPC+BCH, LDPC+CRC32, LDPC 중 한 가지; 변조방식은 QAM(QPSK 포함)으로 하며 변조 규격은 TTA 표준에서 규정한 방식
전송방식은 OFDM 방식으로 하며, 전송 프레임, 전송 다중화 방식, 부트스트랩 등의 송신 규격은 TTA 표준에서 규정한 방식으로 할 것
무선설비 기술적 조건: 주파수허용편차(SFN ±2.1 Hz), 전파형식 D7W·점유대역폭 6 ㎒, 대역외 발사강도(별표 20·21), 스퓨리어스(별표 22), PAPR ≤ 13 ㏈, MER ≥ 27 ㏈, 편파면, 실효복사전력, 안테나 지향특성
지상파 방송사업자가 콘텐츠 보호기술을 도입하고자 하는 경우 … 수상기 제조사와 협의를 거쳐 지상파 UHDTV 방송을 시청할 수 있는 조치가 수반된 경우에 한할 것
이 기준에 규정되지 않은 지상파 초고화질 텔레비전 방송업무에 대한 기술적 특성은 국제전기통신연합에서 정한 조건에 따를 것

regulations.title: TV transmission standards — Next Gen TV transmission standard
regulations.note: FCC fixed incorporation is distinct from the latest voluntary ATSC baseline. A/321:2016 applies under (f)(2)(i); A/322:2017 applies to at least one free OTA primary video stream under (ii). The latter condition sunsets on 17 July 2027 under (iii). Virtual-channel numbering, when used, also refers to A/65C Annex B.

clauses.text: ATSC 3.0 transmissions comply with the incorporated A/321:2016. When virtual channels are used, the major-channel assignment follows the incorporated A/65C:2006 Annex B.
The incorporated A/322:2017 condition concerns transmission of at least one free over-the-air primary video stream. That paragraph sunsets on 17 July 2027.

regulations.id: Decreto nº 12.595, de 27 de agosto de 2025
regulations.title: Dispõe sobre a escolha do padrão tecnológico da segunda geração do Sistema Brasileiro de Televisão Digital Terrestre, denominada TV 3.0, e sobre a sua implantação no território nacional.
regulations.note: Signed 27 Aug 2025, published in the DOU on 28 Aug 2025. Adopts the ATSC 3.0 physical-layer signal standard for TV 3.0 (Art. 3º) with MIMO, LDM and TxID; technical specifications are drafted by Fórum SBTVD and standardized by ABNT (Art. 3º §1º–§2º). Art. 5º lists the system characteristics; Art. 2º of Decreto 11.484/2023 is revoked.

clauses.text: A TV 3.0 adotará o padrão de sinais da camada física do sistema ATSC 3.0, e incorporará, entre outras, as seguintes inovações tecnológicas recomendadas pelo Fórum SBTVD: I - Múltiplas Entradas e Múltiplas Saídas – MIMO; II - Multiplexação por Divisão de Camadas – LDM; e III - Ferramenta de Identificação de Transmissor – TxID.
O Fórum SBTVD elaborará as especificações técnicas a serem adotadas pela TV 3.0 … As especificações técnicas … serão normatizadas pela ABNT.

O padrão tecnológico da TV 3.0 possibilitará: qualidade audiovisual superior; recepção fixa, móvel e portátil; integração entre radiodifusão e internet com interação entre dispositivos; interface baseada em catálogo de aplicativos; segmentação e personalização de conteúdo; uso otimizado do espectro; multiprogramação aprimorada; transmissão de dados como serviço de valor adicionado.

regulations.id: Anatel Ato nº 2.705, de 24 de fevereiro de 2026
regulations.title: Requisitos técnicos provisórios para avaliação da conformidade de transmissores e retransmissores da segunda geração do SBTVD-T – TV 3.0
regulations.note: Signed 24 Feb 2026, published in the Boletim de Serviço on 25 Feb 2026 (in force on publication). Provisional conformity-assessment requirements for TV 3.0 transmitters: the physical layer shall implement ATSC 3.0 per ATSC A/321:2025-07, A/322:2025-07a and A/324:2025-07 (item 4.1); emission mask per RCC-SRA (item 5.8.2); MER of at least 30 dB (item 5.9.2). Definitive requirements under Consulta Pública nº 10/2026.

clauses.text: Os equipamentos básicos de transmissão da camada física (Over-the-Air Physical Layer) da TV 3.0, compreendendo transmissores e retransmissores, devem implementar o padrão ATSC 3.0, em conformidade com as normas ATSC A/321:2025-07, ATSC A/322:2025-07a e ATSC A/324:2025-07 …

Requisito: o equipamento deve atender à máscara de emissão estabelecida nos Requisitos Técnicos de Condições de Uso de Radiofrequências aplicáveis aos Serviços de Radiodifusão de Sons e Imagens, de Retransmissão de Televisão e ao Serviço de Acesso Condicionado.
Taxa de Erro de Modulação (MER) — Requisito: considera-se aceitável um valor de pelo menos 30 dB medido na saída do filtro de RF do transmissor.

regulations.id: Portaria MCom nº 10.693, de 5 de outubro de 2023
regulations.title: Diretrizes complementares para a canalização, cobertura do serviço e harmonização de faixas de frequência para implantação da TV 3.0
regulations.note: Spectrum-policy background: high-VHF 174–216 MHz and UHF 470–608 / 614–698 MHz. The signing date is not an effective date. Publication on 19 October 2023 (DOU nº 199, Seção 1, p.10) is listed by the official MCom SERAD register; Art. 3 puts the ordinance in force on publication. The later Resolução 789/2026 below supplies the current additional channelization.
unverified: The DOU page/PDF itself could not be downloaded in this review; Art. 3 was read from the official DOU search extract and the publication date from the MCom SERAD register.

regulations.id: Anatel Resolução nº 789, de 6 de julho de 2026
regulations.title: Plano de Atribuição, Destinação e Distribuição de Faixas de Frequências no Brasil — PDFF; alterações do RCC-SRA
regulations.effective_rule: Article 5: 30 days counted from publication. 2026-08-12 is computed under LC 95/1998 Art. 8 §1 (publication day and last day counted, in force on the following day); Anatel does not state a calendar date.
regulations.note: Article 2/Table II adds 250–298 and 298–322 MHz alongside 174–216, 470–608 and 614–698 MHz for second-generation digital TV. The 6 July date is the signing date, not the effective date. The associated channelization tables distinguish TVD and TV 3.0.

same.label: Same in stated scope
same.desc: No relevant technical difference found in the explicitly stated feature scope. National option choices and conditional obligations remain separately identified; this does not certify whole-system or receiver interoperability.

partial.label: Partial match
partial.desc: Core is the same but the content differs: missing or stale clauses, errata not reflected, or constraints outside the ATSC-defined options

diff.label: Different
diff.desc: A different technology or specification is adopted

none.label: No equivalent identified
none.desc: The stated search found no direct equivalent, or a separate national document is identified. Unreviewed material is shown as Review needed, not as absence.

review.label: Review needed
review.desc: Counterpart documents identified; clause-level comparison pending

Its ≥−24 dB recommendation is scoped to detection in SFN overlap areas and must be read with mode-specific maximum-level recommendations and AWGN test conditions. BSID applies per broadcast stream, follows the DTV TSID plan and requires SLT@bsid=L1D_bsid; L1D_bsid is active from L1D_version=1. Part 4 I-1 is explicitly not part of the standard.

OG-02 (Sep 2026) Annex A.3–A.4 recommends deriving the BSID from the Anatel call sign (third letter A/B/P/Q/T → 0–4, then the three digits; 0–4999 recommended, 5000–65535 reserved), assigning txid_address sequentially from 0001 in each network and identifying a station by L1D_bsid plus txid_address; it cites A/322:2026-06 Annex N for up to 8,191 transmitters. ATSC.clause: A/322 Annex N; A/324 §5 transmitter controls; A/322 L1D_bsid; A/331 SLT@bsid

ATSC.value: TxID uses a Gold-code DSBSS watermark in the first preamble symbol and defined injection levels. BSID identifies a broadcast stream; RF L1D_bsid and SLT@bsid belong to different signaling layers and must be interpreted with their version/scope rules.
ATSC.req: TxID optional in ATSC; selected-mode and signaling constraints apply

TTA.clause: Part 4 Appendix I-1.12; TTAR §§5–7, Table 5-1 and Appendix II
TTA.value: TTAR provides four-digit TxID allocation, optional activation and BGW/STL or manual control. Its ≥−24 dB recommendation is scoped to detection in SFN overlap areas and must be read with mode-specific maximum-level recommendations and AWGN test conditions. BSID applies per broadcast stream, follows the DTV TSID plan and requires SLT@bsid=L1D_bsid; L1D_bsid is active from L1D_version=1. Part 4 I-1 is explicitly not part of the standard.
TTA.req: TxID optional operating guideline; per-stream BSID assignment/equality prescribed in the guideline; appendix status separate

SBTVD.doc: Decreto 12.595/2025 · Ato 2.705/2026 · SBTVD OG-01 · SBTVD OG-02 (Sep 2026)
SBTVD.clause: Decreto Art.3 III; Ato §4.1; OG-01 §§2,5.6; OG-02 Annex A.3–A.4
SBTVD.value: Decreto includes TxID in TV 3.0. OG-01 discusses 13-bit identifiers, per-polarization choices and a 24 dB injection recommendation, and states TxID use is mandatory while the document itself is non-normative; its September 2026 §2 says each transmitter’s value “should” (previously “shall”) be uniquely assigned per RF channel. OG-02 (Sep 2026) Annex A.3–A.4 recommends deriving the BSID from the Anatel call sign (third letter A/B/P/Q/T → 0–4, then the three digits; 0–4999 recommended, 5000–65535 reserved), assigning txid_address sequentially from 0001 in each network and identifying a station by L1D_bsid plus txid_address; it cites A/322:2026-06 Annex N for up to 8,191 transmitters. This is an assignment method; a station-by-station allocation plan was not identified in the reviewed sources; publication elsewhere is not ruled out.
SBTVD.req: system adoption by decree; transmitter rule; OG-01 statements non-normative; full ABNT operation profile unverified

comparisons.difference: The underlying TxID technology is shared, while national operation and allocation differ. A technical report’s assignment rules, a decree’s system-level adoption and a guideline’s mandatory wording have different authority. Brazil’s public BSID rule is station-based (derived from the call sign), whereas the Korean guideline assigns BSID per broadcast stream following the DTV TSID plan.
comparisons.impact: Use of a different BSID per stream and correct L1/SLT consistency are distinct from transmitter identification. Actual TxID injection, allocation compliance and received identifiers were not tested.

TTA.text: Mechanism corresponds; national optional operation, assignment guidance, appendix status and version conditions are additional distinctions.

SBTVD.text: Decree and public operating guidance, including the OG-02 BSID/TxID assignment method, verified; normative ABNT operation/assignment details not fully verified.

comparisons.feature: TxID RF mechanism, national operation and per-stream BSID assignment

ATSC.clause: A/322 Annex N; A/324 §5 transmitter controls; A/322 L1D_bsid; A/331 SLT@bsid
ATSC.page: A/322 pp.253–256 and §9.3.1; A/331 SLT definition
ATSC.value: TxID uses a Gold-code DSBSS watermark in the first preamble symbol and defined injection levels. BSID identifies a broadcast stream; RF L1D_bsid and SLT@bsid belong to different signaling layers and must be interpreted with their version/scope rules.
ATSC.req: TxID optional in ATSC; selected-mode and signaling constraints apply

TTA.clause: Part 4 Appendix I-1.12; TTAR §§5–7, Table 5-1 and Appendix II
TTA.value: TTAR provides four-digit TxID allocation, optional activation and BGW/STL or manual control. Its ≥−24 dB recommendation is scoped to detection in SFN overlap areas and must be read with mode-specific maximum-level recommendations and AWGN test conditions. BSID applies per broadcast stream, follows the DTV TSID plan and requires SLT@bsid=L1D_bsid; L1D_bsid is active from L1D_version=1. Part 4 I-1 is explicitly not part of the standard.
TTA.req: TxID optional operating guideline; per-stream BSID assignment/equality prescribed in the guideline; appendix status separate

SBTVD.doc: Decreto 12.595/2025 · Ato 2.705/2026 · SBTVD OG-01 · SBTVD OG-02 (Sep 2026)
SBTVD.clause: Decreto Art.3 III; Ato §4.1; OG-01 §§2,5.6; OG-02 Annex A.3–A.4
SBTVD.value: Decreto includes TxID in TV 3.0. OG-01 discusses 13-bit identifiers, per-polarization choices and a 24 dB injection recommendation, and states TxID use is mandatory while the document itself is non-normative; its September 2026 §2 says each transmitter’s value “should” (previously “shall”) be uniquely assigned per RF channel. OG-02 (Sep 2026) Annex A.3–A.4 recommends deriving the BSID from the Anatel call sign (third letter A/B/P/Q/T → 0–4, then the three digits; 0–4999 recommended, 5000–65535 reserved), assigning txid_address sequentially from 0001 in each network and identifying a station by L1D_bsid plus txid_address; it cites A/322:2026-06 Annex N for up to 8,191 transmitters. This is an assignment method; a station-by-station allocation plan was not identified in the reviewed sources; publication elsewhere is not ruled out.
SBTVD.req: system adoption by decree; transmitter rule; OG-01 statements non-normative; full ABNT operation profile unverified

comparisons.difference: The underlying TxID technology is shared, while national operation and allocation differ. A technical report’s assignment rules, a decree’s system-level adoption and a guideline’s mandatory wording have different authority. Brazil’s public BSID rule is station-based (derived from the call sign), whereas the Korean guideline assigns BSID per broadcast stream following the DTV TSID plan.
comparisons.impact: Use of a different BSID per stream and correct L1/SLT consistency are distinct from transmitter identification. Actual TxID injection, allocation compliance and received identifiers were not tested.

TTA.text: Mechanism corresponds; national optional operation, assignment guidance, appendix status and version conditions are additional distinctions.

SBTVD.text: Decree and public operating guidance, including the OG-02 BSID/TxID assignment method, verified; normative ABNT operation/assignment details not fully verified.
